Question
========

```{r include=FALSE}
include_supplement("destinations.R",
                   recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r}
source("destinations.R")
```



```{r terms-sample}
terms_sample <- sample(destinations, 2)
```


Betrachten Sie folgende Aussage $A$, eine Implikation:


"Wenn *`r terms_sample[1]`*, dann *`r terms_sample[2]`*."



*Hinweis*: "Nicht-A" bedeutet, dass A *nicht* der Fall ist.


Welche Antwort ist im Hinblick auf $A$ formallogisch korrekt? Wählen Sie die korrekte Antwort aus!




```{r truth_table_implication}
tt_implication <-  # CORRECT
  tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(T, F, T, T)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(T, T, T, T)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = paste0("*",p_sample, "* ist der Fall und *", q_sample,"* ist der Fall. Also ist die oben genannte Implikation ", implic_de,"."))
```




```{r}
itemlist_correct <- 
  tt_implication %>% 
  sample_n(1)
```


```{r}
tt_implication_false <-  # INCORRECT
    tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(F, F, F, F)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = paste0("*",p_sample, "* ist der Fall und *", q_sample,"* ist der Fall. Also ist die oben genannte Implikation ", implic_de,".")) 
```




```{r}
tt_modus_tollens_false <-  # INCORRECT
  tibble(
    p = c(T, T, F, F),
    q = c(T, F, T, F),
    pq = c("TT", "TF", "FT", "FF"),
    implic = c(T, T, T, F)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(p_sample = paste0(ifelse(p==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[1]),
         q_sample = paste0(ifelse(q==TRUE,"", "Nicht-"), terms_sample[2]),
         implic_de = ifelse(implic, "wahr", "falsch"),
         is_correct = c(F, F, F, F)) %>% 
  mutate(proposition = glue("Wenn *{q_sample}*, dann *{p_sample}*. Also ist die oben genannte Implikation {implic_de}.")) 
```





```{r}
itemlist_incorrect <- 
  tt_implication_false %>% 
  bind_rows(tt_modus_tollens_false) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 4)  # 4 wrong options


itemlist <-
  itemlist_correct %>% 
  bind_rows(itemlist_incorrect) #%>% 
  #sample_n(size = nrow(.))  # shuffle_it
```





```{r itemlist, results="asis"}
answerlist(itemlist$proposition, markup = "markdown")
```







Solution
========

Die richtige Aussage lautet "`r itemlist$proposition[itemlist$is_correct==TRUE]`".



```{r itemlist_asnwer, results="asis"}
answerlist(ifelse(itemlist$is_correct, "Wahr", "Falsch"), markup = "markdown")
```
